**Precipitation layers live in the **Weather** category of the NCOP sidebar.** They are grouped into three sub‑categories:

| Layer | What it shows | Sub‑category |
|-------|---------------|--------------|
| Weekly Precipitation (2 m Above Ground) | Total rain over the past week at 2 m height | Meteoblue Forecast |
| Hourly Precipitation (2 m Above Ground) | Hour‑by‑hour rain at 2 m height | Meteoblue Forecast |
| Precipitation Radar | Real‑time radar‑derived rain intensity | Meteoblue Forecast |
| Accumulated Precipitation | Total rain accumulated over a chosen period | Global Deterministic Prediction System (GDPS) |
| Precipitation Type / 3 hrs | Expected rain, snow, etc. for the next 3 h | Global Deterministic Prediction System (GDPS) |
| Convective Precipitation Weekly | Forecasted thunderstorm‑related rain (kg/m²) for the next 10 days | Global Deterministic Prediction System (GDPS) |
| IMERG Precipitation Rate (14 Days) | Rain rates from the past 14 days (satellite‑derived) | Radar Layers |

You’ll find them by expanding **Weather** → then selecting the appropriate sub‑category (Meteoblue Forecast, GDPS, or Radar Layers). 🚀
